metaTitle: CRD 50 95 4 1 3 B Cotton: Yield and Maturity
metaDescription: CRD 50 95 4 1 3 B cotton is a cotton variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: CRD 50 95 4 1 3 B is a registered cotton variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2000 as NSIC 2000 Ct 11. Cotton Development Administration bred it. Its record notes 2.44 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about CRD 50 95 4 1 3 B cotton
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Its average yield of 2.44 t/ha beats the average of its group, 2.15. It sits in the top quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: The pests and diseases that hit cotton fields most often: [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [Fusarium wilt](/diseases/fusarium-wilt), [thrips](/pests/thrips). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant CRD 50 95 4 1 3 B cotton
Cotton needs a long dry spell at boll opening. Pick a variety by lint yield and fiber quality. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng puno](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-puno).
